mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, SELLER_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PAYMENT_METHOD, TOTAL_AMOUNT, STATUS, ORDER_DATE, PAYMENT_KEY ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{customerName}, #{sellerName}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{paymentMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{paymentKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.USER_ID, o.CUSTOMER_NAME, o.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, o.PAYMENT_METHOD, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT, o.STATUS, o.ORDER_DATE, o.PAYMENT_KEY FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE o.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.USER_ID, o.CUSTOMER_NAME, o.PRODUCT_ID, o.PRODUCT_NAME, -- ✅ 상품명 직접 반환 o.PAYMENT_METHOD, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT, o.STATUS, o.ORDER_DATE, o.PAYMENT_KEY FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY o.ORDER_DATE DESC
SELECT ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, TOTAL_AMOUNT AS PRICE, TO_CHAR(ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE, CUSTOMER_NAME, SELLER_NAME FROM ORDERS ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC
